:::{#exm-expand-index-shorthand}
#### Writing out an index shorthand

Let $n = 3$ and $(x_1, x_2, x_3) = (2, 5, 1)$.
A source that writes $\sum_{i} x_i$ means $\sumto{i}{3} x_i$:

$$
\ba
\sumto{i}{3} x_i
&= x_1 + x_2 + x_3
&& \text{(definition of summation notation)} \\
&= 2 + 5 + 1
&& \text{(substitute the values)} \\
&= 8
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

:::
